name: empty-state
description: One title, one short description, and at most one primary action when a collection has no content.
avoidWhen: Do not use for loading or errors.

ux.behaviour: One title, one line, at most one action, centred in whatever height it is given; TalkBack reads the title and line as one item
ux.why: An empty screen should say what is missing and the one thing to do about it, then stop talking

ux.behaviour: The action is a full AppButton: it presses under your finger and refuses a double tap
ux.why: The first thing you make from an empty screen should feel like every other action in the app

ux.behaviour: Never used for loading or errors; those have their own patterns
ux.why: Empty is a fact, not a failure

aiHints: Pass fillMaxSize (or other extra height) when this is the only content on the screen so the stack centers
Do not add a second button or a text link next to the primary action
